title: List an acoustic guitar
ask: I'm selling my acoustic guitar. Notes are in item.md, recent sales in comps.csv. Write the listing and post it this evening.
background: It is a dreadnought with a solid spruce top, bought in 2019.
There is a small dent on the back from a belt buckle, and it comes with a hard case.
I teach on weekday afternoons, so evenings are when I can answer questions.

constraints.text: ask between $450 and $520 and write the price as "Price: $..."
end with the line "Pickup: Dulwich Hill"
keep every sentence to 18 words or fewer
post the listing after 17:30, not before
mention the small dent on the back

New strings fitted.
Pickup: Dulwich Hill.
